input.summary:
Chimneys, hearths and lights (parts/hearth.mjs) builds cleanly: chimney S's cap ring now skips the two cells the roof already fills (7,26,30 and 8,26,30), so the part reports 0 refused and 0 off-palette.
Chimney E and S, the first-floor hearth, the wing range and the lantern chains are all placed (244 blocks); make.sh produced build.nbt.
Only parts/hearth.mjs was edited: the wrapper that drops locked-cell writes is now generic (leaveCells(g, owned)), with a ROOF_OWNED set beside SHELL_OWNED.

waste.what: Found the two refused cells by reading parts-report.json and the make.sh log, then worked out which roof cells the chimney S cap ring hit by hand.
waste.cost: 2 make.sh runs and 2 report reads; the cell-to-owner lookup was done in my head
waste.tool: make.sh (or runParts) should print each refused cell with the earlier part that owns it (e.g. 'owned by Roofs'), and runParts could take a skipLocked option so a helper's writes into earlier parts are dropped with a count instead of refused and reported.

waste.what: Wrote the same drop-the-locked-cells wrapper that chimney E already had, by copy-and-adapt, to fix chimney S.
waste.cost: one edit to generalise the wrapper and one line changed at each call site
waste.tool: A library wrapper, e.g. guardLocked(g, earlierCells) or runParts' skipLocked, would replace the per-part copies of leaveShellCells.

companions.task: Confirm that the wing gable's slates at y 26 (x 7..8, z 30) should keep the roof's cells, so the chimney S cap ring skips them, and that no flue cell is left open.
Check that the chimney S cap ring still reads as a closed ring with a gap only at the gable side, now that two cells on that side are roof.

left: Other parts still refuse writes (not in this fix): Grounds and garden wants gravel at (20..21, 5, 13..14), but this part's chimney E footing is bricks there; the aisle room part wants a lantern at (12, 11, 17) where this part's iron chain runs, and (12, 12, 17) conflicts with that chain too; the wing kitchen room wants a smoker at (7, 6, 29), where this part's furnace is.
Chimney S's cap ring now has no brick_slab on the two gable-side cells at y 26, so the cap ring has a gap there (intended: the roof owns it).
